root.label: Oregon Housing Stability Council conflict investigation

events.label: Oregon Housing Stability Council conflict investigation

slots.name: investigation date
slots.sentence: In December, a state investigation revealed that an appointee to Oregon’s Housing Stability Council, the body that approves housing subsidies, had violated a state conflict-of-interest law by voting to award money to projects designed by the architecture firm where she worked.

slots.name: commission outcome
slots.sentence: The commission gave her a warning letter.

slots.name: appointee status
slots.sentence: The appointee, who later resigned, told an investigator she believed she had followed high ethical standards and had recused herself from voting on projects she worked on.
